notes:
- No more window freezes on the shortcuts: Ctrl+Q, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+E and Ctrl+T now do their work in the background,
   so PokeFlow keeps drawing smoothly (it froze 0.5 s on every Ctrl+Q and up to 2.8 s on Ctrl+E during a 3-second block).
   They still run one at a time, in the order you press them, and pressing again still cancels.
 - AI pokes look like the built-in ones: straight apostrophes and a lowercase "i" ("i'm", "i'll").
